title.zh: 马尔萨斯陷阱（第 6 题）

description.en: Income per person as a slope, why population returns to the same point after any shock, what to draw for the marks, and what finally broke the trap.
description.zh: 人均收入是一条斜率，为什么任何冲击之后人口都回到原点，为拿分要画什么，以及最后是什么打破了陷阱。

description.en: Thinking that more total output means a higher standard of living
description.zh: 以为总产出多了，生活水平就高了

items.en: **a.** Draw a ray from the origin whose slope is subsistence income $y^*$. The equilibrium $(N^*, Y^*)$ is where it meets $Y = A f(N, K)$.
items.zh: **a.** 从原点画一条斜率为生存收入 $y^*$ 的射线。均衡 $(N^*, Y^*)$ 是它与 $Y = A f(N, K)$ 的交点。

items.en: **b.** Immigrants move the economy right along the curve to $N_1$. Output rises, but output per person falls below $y^*$ (diminishing returns), so deaths exceed births and the population shrinks back to $N^*$, with output back at $Y^*$.
items.zh: **b.** 移民让经济沿曲线右移到 $N_1$。总产出上升，但人均产出降到 $y^*$ 以下（边际收益递减），于是死亡多于出生，人口缩回 $N^*$，产出也回到 $Y^*$。

items.en: Diminishing returns to labour when land and capital are fixed.
items.zh: 土地和资本固定时，劳动的边际收益递减。

items.en: Income per person $Y/N$ as the slope of a ray from the origin.
items.zh: 人均收入 $Y/N$ 是一条过原点射线的斜率。

items.en: Population that grows above subsistence and shrinks below it.
items.zh: 人口在生存水平之上增长、之下减少。

title.en: Income per person is a slope
title.zh: 人均收入就是一条斜率

text.en: For a point $(N, Y)$ on the curve, income per person $Y/N$ is the slope of the line from the origin to that point. The production curve is concave (each extra worker adds less, because land and capital are fixed), so these rays get **flatter** as you move right: more people, less each.
text.zh: 对曲线上的一点 $(N, Y)$，人均收入 $Y/N$ 就是原点到这一点连线的斜率。生产曲线是凹的（土地和资本固定，每多一个劳动力增加的产出越来越少），所以越往右这条射线越**平**：人越多，每人分得越少。

text.en: The two assumptions that make the trap

items.en: **Diminishing returns to labour** with fixed technology $A$ and capital (or land) $K$: the concave curve.
items.zh: **劳动的边际收益递减**，技术 $A$ 和资本（或土地）$K$ 固定：凹的曲线。

items.en: **Population responds to income per person**: above subsistence $y^*$, births exceed deaths and $N$ grows; below it, $N$ shrinks.
items.zh: **人口随人均收入变化**：高于生存水平 $y^*$ 时出生多于死亡，$N$ 增长；低于时 $N$ 减少。

text.en: So the economy settles where $Y/N = y^*$: on the ray with slope $y^*$. Left of $N^*$ the curve is above the ray and the population grows; right of it the curve is below and the population shrinks. Both push toward $N^*$: the equilibrium is **stable**.
text.zh: 于是经济停在 $Y/N = y^*$ 处：斜率为 $y^*$ 的那条射线上。$N^*$ 左边曲线在射线上方，人口增长；右边曲线在射线下方，人口减少。两边都往 $N^*$ 推：这个均衡是**稳定**的。

caption.en: The scene plays a wave of immigrants, then a better technology. Then drag the population along the curve: the gold ray's slope is income per person, and the arrow shows where the population heads. Raise the technology $A$: the population grows until income per person is back at $y^*$.
caption.zh: 画面先演一波移民，再演一次技术进步。然后沿曲线拖动人口：金色射线的斜率就是人均收入，箭头指向人口要去的方向。提高技术 $A$：人口会一直增长，直到人均收入回到 $y^*$。

alt.en: The concave production curve Y = A·f(N, K) and a straight ray from the origin with slope y*, the subsistence income. They meet at (N*, Y*), marked with dashed lines to both axes.
alt.zh: 凹的生产曲线 Y = A·f(N, K)，以及从原点出发、斜率为生存收入 y* 的直线射线。两者交于 (N*, Y*)，用虚线连到两轴。

caption.en: What earns the marks: the ray labelled with its slope $y^*$, the crossing point, and $N^*$ and $Y^*$ marked on the axes.
caption.zh: 拿分的要点：射线标明斜率 $y^*$，标出交点，并在两轴上标 $N^*$ 和 $Y^*$。

text.en: Say in one sentence why it is an equilibrium: at $N^*$ income per person equals subsistence, so births equal deaths and the population stays put.
text.zh: 用一句话说明它为什么是均衡：在 $N^*$ 处人均收入等于生存水平，出生等于死亡，人口不再变。

alt.en: The same curve and ray. A point further right at N1 has a flatter dashed ray from the origin, so income per person there, Y1/N1, is below y*. An arrow along the N axis points from N1 back to N*.
alt.zh: 同样的曲线和射线。更靠右的 N1 处，原点到它的虚线射线更平，所以那里的人均收入 Y1/N1 低于 y*。N 轴上一支箭头从 N1 指回 N*。

caption.en: Show the jump to $N_1$, the flatter ray (income per person below $y^*$), and the arrow back to $N^*$.
caption.zh: 画出跳到 $N_1$、更平的射线（人均收入低于 $y^*$），以及回到 $N^*$ 的箭头。

title.en: A model answer for the box

body.en: Immigration raises the population from $N^*$ to $N_1$. With fixed technology and capital, diminishing returns mean output rises less than in proportion, so income per person falls below the subsistence level $y^*$. Below subsistence, the death rate exceeds the birth rate and the population declines. It keeps declining until income per person is back at $y^*$, at the original $N^*$ and $Y^*$. In the long run the immigration changes nothing: the standard of living is pinned at subsistence.
body.zh: 移民使人口从 $N^*$ 增加到 $N_1$。技术和资本不变，边际收益递减，产出增加的比例小于人口，所以人均收入降到生存水平 $y^*$ 以下。低于生存水平时死亡率高于出生率，人口下降，一直降到人均收入回到 $y^*$，即原来的 $N^*$ 和 $Y^*$。长期看，移民什么也没改变：生活水平被钉在生存水平。

text.en: The exam can swap the immigrants for any other shock. Ask two questions: does it move the **point** along the curve, or move the **curve** (or the ray)? Then follow income per person.
text.zh: 考试可以把移民换成别的冲击。问两个问题：它是让**点**沿曲线动，还是让**曲线**（或射线）动？然后跟着人均收入走。

rows.en: Better technology ($A$ up) or more land
rows.zh: 技术进步（$A$ 提高）或更多土地

rows.en: Higher subsistence norm (later marriage, fewer births at each income)
rows.zh: 生存标准提高（晚婚，同样收入下出生更少）

rows.en: fewer people, richer: $Y/N$ rises to the new $y^*$
rows.zh: 人更少、更富：$Y/N$ 升到新的 $y^*$

prompt.en: People start to marry later, so at every income fewer children are born; the population is stable only at a higher income per person. In the long run…
prompt.zh: 人们开始晚婚，同样收入下出生的孩子更少；人口只有在更高的人均收入下才稳定。长期里……

label.en: income per person is higher and the population smaller
label.zh: 人均收入更高，人口更少

label.en: nothing changes: everything returns to the old $N^*$
label.zh: 什么都不变：一切回到原来的 $N^*$

feedback.en: That holds for shocks that move the point along the curve. This one moves the ray: the new equilibrium is where the steeper ray meets the curve.
feedback.zh: 那是让点沿曲线动的冲击才成立。这个冲击让射线动了：新均衡在更陡的射线与曲线的交点。

label.en: the population is larger, as with better technology
label.zh: 人口更多，和技术进步一样

feedback.en: Better technology moves the curve up and keeps $y^*$. Here $y^*$ itself rises, and the steeper ray meets the curve further left.
feedback.zh: 技术进步让曲线上移、$y^*$ 不变。这里是 $y^*$ 本身上升，更陡的射线在更靠左的地方与曲线相交。

explain.en: The only way out of the trap inside this model is to change the population rule itself: a steeper ray meets the concave curve at a smaller $N$, where income per person is higher.
explain.zh: 在这个模型里，走出陷阱的唯一办法是改变人口规则本身：更陡的射线在更小的 $N$ 处与凹曲线相交，那里人均收入更高。

title.zh: 最后是什么打破了陷阱

items.en: In the Malthusian world, better technology only buys more people at the same living standard: for most of history, average income barely moved.
items.zh: 在马尔萨斯世界里，技术进步只换来更多的人，生活水平不变：人类历史的大部分时间里，平均收入几乎没变。

items.en: Modern growth escaped because technology kept improving faster than population, and population growth stopped tracking income (the **demographic transition**: richer families had fewer children).
items.zh: 现代增长走出了陷阱：技术进步一直快于人口增长，而且人口增长不再跟着收入走（**人口转变** demographic transition：越富的家庭孩子越少）。

items.en: In exam answers, keep the language of the model: "diminishing returns", "subsistence", "birth and death rates", "returns to the original equilibrium".
items.zh: 答题时用模型的术语：“边际收益递减 diminishing returns”“生存水平 subsistence”“出生率和死亡率 birth and death rates”“回到原来的均衡 returns to the original equilibrium”。

title.en: Say it in your own words

prompt.en: In two or three sentences: what happens in the Malthusian model after a large wave of immigration, and why?
prompt.zh: 用两三句话：马尔萨斯模型里来了一大波移民之后会发生什么？为什么？

key_points.en: Output per person falls below subsistence, because of diminishing returns to labour
key_points.zh: 因为劳动的边际收益递减，人均产出降到生存水平以下

key_points.en: Below subsistence, deaths exceed births, so the population falls
key_points.zh: 低于生存水平时死亡多于出生，人口下降

key_points.en: In the long run population, output and income per person return to their original levels
key_points.zh: 长期里人口、产出和人均收入都回到原来的水平

model_answer.en: Immigration raises population, and with diminishing returns output per person falls below subsistence. Then deaths exceed births and the population falls back until income per person returns to subsistence, at the original population and output.
model_answer.zh: 移民增加了人口，由于边际收益递减，人均产出降到生存水平以下。于是死亡多于出生，人口回落，直到人均收入回到生存水平，人口和产出也回到原来的水平。

explain.en: Three links: diminishing returns (income per person falls), the population rule (deaths exceed births), and the return to the same equilibrium.
explain.zh: 三个环节：边际收益递减（人均收入下降）、人口规则（死亡多于出生）、回到同一个均衡。

prompt.en: A new farming technology raises $A$. In the Malthusian long run, what happens to income per person?
prompt.zh: 一项新的农业技术提高了 $A$。在马尔萨斯的长期里，人均收入会怎样？

label.en: It returns to subsistence, with a larger population
label.zh: 回到生存水平，人口更多

feedback.en: Only for a while: above subsistence the population grows until income per person is back at $y^*$.
feedback.zh: 只是暂时的：高于生存水平时人口增长，直到人均收入回到 $y^*$。

feedback.en: More output per worker cannot lower income per person; it raises it, until the population catches up.
feedback.zh: 每个劳动力产出更多，不会降低人均收入；它会先提高，直到人口追上来。

explain.en: The curve shifts up, income per person rises above $y^*$, the population grows, and the economy settles on the same ray at a larger $N$ and $Y$.
explain.zh: 曲线上移，人均收入高于 $y^*$，人口增长，经济停在同一条射线上，$N$ 和 $Y$ 都更大。

prompt.en: Output is $Y = 6\sqrt{N}$ and subsistence income is $y^* = 2$. What is the Malthusian equilibrium population $N^*$?
prompt.zh: 产出 $Y = 6\sqrt{N}$，生存收入 $y^* = 2$。马尔萨斯均衡人口 $N^*$ 是多少？

hints.en: Income per person is $Y/N = 6/\sqrt{N}$; set it equal to $y^*$.
